sections.putIn: City of Pineville Elk River Access
sections.notes: Put-in City of Pineville Elk River Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Mount Shira Access: exact agency access pin. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

putInAccess.note: MDC Discover Nature — Boat Ramp features, OBJECTID 590 (Boat ramp (MDC)) is the managing agency's own access feature, 51 m from the USGS NHD High Resolution flowline of the Elk River. Imagery check 2026-10-30: Pin at a parking area, path head or ramp head within roughly 40-60 m of the water with a visible route to the bank. Public access: Missouri Department of Conservation — City of Pineville Elk River Access (area page).
